title: haex-hive Visibility Marker v1
description: Schema for .haex-hive/visibility.json — the sole publication event for a completed haex install transaction. See Spec 008 FR-004, FR-005.

haex_hive_version.description: Matches the Spec 007 unified-manifest version this install belongs to.

generation_id.description: Deterministic per-plan generation identifier. See Spec 008 research §R8.

install_lock_content_integrity.description: SRI-style digest of the sealed install.lock bytes.

participating_roots.description: One entry per participating output root. Order MUST be lexicographic on `root` for determinism.

written_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 wall-clock at marker write. Informational only; verification uses generation_id + digests.

sriDigest.description: SRI-style SHA-256 digest, base64url-nopad (43 chars for 32 bytes).

root.description: Repo-relative directory path with trailing slash. Examples: '.haex-hive/', '.claude/', '.codex/'.

content_integrity.description: Per-root digest computed per Spec 008 research §R5.

items.description: Repo-relative POSIX path under the root.

oneOf.description: Exhaustive overlay-owned-path allowlist for a mixed-ownership root.
haex-owned root; the whole tree is owned.

overlay_paths.description: Present for mixed-ownership roots (.claude/, .codex/, adapter roots). Null or absent for haex-owned roots.
